notify_user.desc: Fire-and-forget desktop notification — never blocks, never returns a reply, and returns only delivery metadata to avoid echoing long messages. Use freely for progress milestones: task start, completion, errors, phase changes. Do NOT use when you need the user's answer — use ask_user for that.

params.title: Notification title. Default: "AI Assistant".
params.duration_seconds: How long the toast stays visible (Windows/Linux only). Default: 5.

ask_user.desc: Open a browser dialog to ask the user a question. Returns a token immediately — the dialog is non-blocking. Call get_user_response(token=...) right after to wait for the answer. Use ONLY when you genuinely need a human decision before continuing — not to share information, progress, or summaries (put those in your chat response instead). Ask exactly one question; keep it short. Put supporting context in details, not in the question itself. Providing choices adds quick-reply chips, but the user can always type a free reply too.

params.question: One short, focused question. No reasoning, code, or explanations here — those belong in details or your chat response.
params.details: Optional markdown context shown below the question: summaries, findings, diffs, tables, relevant background. This is where substance belongs.
params.title: Dialog window title. Default: "AI Assistant".
params.subtitle: Subtitle shown under the title — e.g. your agent or model name.
params.choices: Optional quick-reply chip buttons (array of strings). User can tap a chip and/or type a custom reply.
params.timeout_seconds: Auto-cancel after this many idle seconds. Default: 600. Max: 3600.
params.notify: Send a desktop notification when the dialog opens to alert the user. Default: true.

get_user_response.desc: Wait for a pending ask_user or rest dialog to be answered. Blocks up to wait_seconds per call, then returns. You MUST keep calling this in a loop until the result is NOT a PENDING string — the user may take a long time to reply. User replies are capped by default so pasted content cannot flood AI context. Possible non-PENDING results: the user's reply text; "[User dismissed the dialog — no reply was sent]"; "[Dialog cancelled by AI]"; "[User did not respond within the allotted time]".

params.token: Token returned by ask_user or rest. Required.
params.wait_seconds: Seconds to block per poll. Default: 55. Max: 115.
params.max_response_bytes: Maximum bytes to return from the user's reply. Default: 262144 (256 KB). Set 0 for unlimited.

update_dialog.desc: Push a live message into an open ask_user dialog while waiting for the user's reply. Appears instantly in a timestamped updates panel — no page refresh. Use this to share intermediate findings or thinking while the user is still deciding. Non-blocking. Has no effect after the dialog is answered or dismissed.

params.message: Message to display. Rendered as full markdown — headings, lists, code blocks, tables all work.
params.replace_last: Replace the previous update instead of appending a new one. Useful for live-updating a progress counter. Default: false.

cancel_ask_user.desc: Dismiss an open ask_user dialog immediately. The browser page closes and the next get_user_response call returns "[Dialog cancelled by AI]". Use when the question is no longer relevant — e.g. you already have the answer, the task was aborted, or you are replacing it with a new ask_user call.

rest.desc: Put the AI into a resting state: opens a browser page with a wake-up button and waits for the user to resume. IMPORTANT: call this — do NOT end the conversation — whenever the user says 'take a rest', 'wait', 'stand by', 'I'll review', or any equivalent pause phrase. macOS and Windows only. Workflow: (1) call rest() — it returns a JSON object with status, token, and instructions; (2) parse the token from the JSON; (3) loop get_user_response(token=...) indefinitely until you receive a non-PENDING result.

params.notes: Message shown to the user while the AI is resting. Rendered as markdown — summarize where you left off.
params.title: Name shown in the resting UI. Default: "AI Assistant".
params.subtitle: Optional subtitle — e.g. your model name.
params.timeout_seconds: Auto-wake if user does not respond within this many seconds. Default: 3600. Max: 86400.
